svg.text: PK primary key · UK unique · FK foreign key · 1:N one-to-many
Referential actions (onDelete): Event→Organiser R · Event→ProgrammeItem/TicketType/StaffToken C · Registration→Event/TicketType R · Registration→Payment/CheckIn/AttendeeRequest R
SQL-only guarantees (not expressible in Prisma): CHECK constraints · partial UNIQUE (one success Payment per Registration) · forbidden-transition & append-only triggers
